rationale: The interpreter identified several ambiguities that remain unresolved. Each ambiguity requires clarification from the ticket owner before a complete and reliable implementation can be defined. Consequently, the review contains multiple OPEN_AMBIGUITY findings, preventing a PASS status.

findings.action: Obtain clarification on the full set of Roof Type options and the representation method for parapet/shrouding.
